snippet.title: Pionero Capital - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Start with a small garage. Build a business empire with your friends.

Pionero Capital is a co-op open-world business simulator where you source products, pack orders, and make deliveries to grow your company. Hire employees, expand your fleet, and move into bigger garages and offices as you work your way to the top.

And when business is booming? Spend your earnings on cars, mansions, and a new look.

Coming to Steam Early Access on November 4.

Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3275210/Pionero_Capital/

#PioneroCapital #OpenWorld #Coop
